---
title: Bullets, table, bullets
format: pptx
_quarto:
  tests:
    pptx:
      ensurePptxMaxSlides:
        - 2
      ensurePptxLayout:
        -
          - 2
          - "Title and Content"
      ensurePptxRegexMatches:
        - ['<a:t>before two</a:t>[\s\S]*<a:tbl>[\s\S]*<a:t>after one</a:t>']
        - 2
---

<!--
Characterization test for the Pandoc 3.10.1 slide splitting change
(jgm/pandoc#11433): a slide holding a bullet list, a table, then another
bullet list stays on a single "Title and Content" slide. Pandoc 3.10 put the
first list and the table on one slide and moved the trailing list to the next.
The title slide is slide 1, so the content slide is slide 2.
-->

## Slide

- before one
- before two

| a | b |
|---|---|
| 1 | 2 |

- after one
- after two
